title: Fix the Amount Sent
description: A merchant must receive at least a quoted amount of EURC, but the player only wants to spend a fixed amount of USDC. The wallet has to pick the operation whose source amount cannot move.

content.prompt: Which Stellar operation fixes the amount of the asset sent while the received amount varies with the conversion path?

hint: Strict Send debits exactly the send amount and returns whatever the path yields above the destination minimum. Strict Receive is the mirror image: the received amount is fixed and the sent amount varies. Documentation: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/build/guides/transactions/path-payments
author: StellarHunts Core

testCases.title: Strict Send fixes the source amount
Strict Receive fixes the destination amount
Sell offers are not path payments
